labs.pi_title: Director, MIT Sea Grant; Henry L. and Grace Doherty Professor in Ocean Science and Engineering
labs.admin_name: Coretta Granberry (Research Program Administrator); Caroline Johnston (Financial Administrator)
labs.research_summary: MIT's federally/state-funded ocean, coastal and Great Lakes research, education and outreach program; includes two named sub-groups, the AUV Lab and the Design Lab.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 Director, 1 Associate Director (Themis Sapsis), ~9 research/advisory/education staff, 3 AUV Lab staff, 4 Design Lab staff (incl. 1 emeritus director), 4 research affiliates, 3 program-support/financial staff
labs.join_notes: Student opportunities page lists ways to get involved; no specific open staff positions seen on this pass.
labs.notes: Breadth+partial-depth pass from the program's own People page. Themis Sapsis (Associate Director) is also independently a PI in MIT Mechanical/Ocean Engineering -- not separately recorded here to avoid duplication if/when that department is scraped. AUV Lab and Design Lab are named internal groups led by research engineers/scientists (DeFilippo, Sacarny, Randeni; Chalfant, Chryssostomidis, Karniada) rather than separate faculty PIs, so recorded as sub-groups in this one entry rather than as separate labs.
